label: Expanded economic capital into cultural, social, and symbolic forms of capital
description: Pierre Bourdieu adopted Karl Marx's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Karl Marx's perspective to Pierre Bourdieu's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 19th Century Divergences across history into the Contemporary & Post-Structural.

label: Merleau-Ponty's bodily intentionality provided the phenomenological grounding for habitus
description: Pierre Bourdieu adopted Maurice Merleau-Ponty's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Maurice Merleau-Ponty's perspective to Pierre Bourdieu's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis across history into the Contemporary & Post-Structural.

label: Formulated habitus and social field theory to explain the reproduction of class hierarchy
description: Pierre Bourdieu formulated and introduced the concept of "Habitus & Cultural Capital", which became a seminal contribution in social-theory philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in social-theory.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Contemporary & Post-Structural as part of Pierre Bourdieu's canonical writings.

label: Shared deep critique of institutional disciplinary power, bodily norms, and symbolic domination
description: Michel Foucault synthesized Pierre Bourdieu's framework with contrasting philosophical traditions to produce a novel unified philosophical system.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Pierre Bourdieu's perspective to Michel Foucault's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Contemporary & Post-Structural era.
